quarterly_data.quarter: Viavi press release: VIAVI T/Rx Selected by U.S. Army Threat Systems Management (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The U.S. Army's Threat Systems Management Office (TSMO), under Portfolio Acquisition Executive C2/CC2, selected the VIAVI T/Rx software defined transceiver system to provide the electromagnetic spectrum (EMS) environment at Army test ranges opened to private industry under the Test Range Private Industry Initiative (five range facilities for commercial developers of drones, counter-drone systems, long-range fires and low-cost interceptors); TSMO will use the T/Rx to fulfill 'a large portion of this requirement'. The T/Rx (compact, rugged, commercial software defined transceiver combining simultaneous signal generation and collection in one field-deployable unit) delivered on-demand EMS complexity at a Camp Grayling electromagnetic test in September 2026. No contract value disclosed.
